'''Popo's Sweet Drexl Sausage in Nectarwine''' was a flavorful [[Sausage/Legends|sausage]] invented by [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Napo Popotis|Popotis]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] found in his [[Book/Legends|cookbook]], ''[[Delicacies from the Demon Moon]]''. It was served in [[nectarwine]].<ref name="Cookbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Popo's Sweet Drexl Sausage in Nectarwine is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' in the codex entry for 'Delicacies from the Demon Moon'.<ref name="Cookbook" />
